{{Quote|Senator Organa&hellip; the Supreme Chancellor requests your presence at a special session of Congress.|[[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
A '''special session of Congress''',<ref name="ROTS" /> also known as an '''Extraordinary Session''', '''Grand Convocation'''<ref name="ROTS novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> or a '''special session of the senate''',<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> was a special meeting of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] called by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] to which every [[Senator/Legends|senator]] was obliged to attend.<ref name="ROTS" />

Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, called a Special Session to issue his [[Declaration of a New Order]] and begin the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This Special Session was held in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] summoned [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] to the session. Palpatine stated that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had tried to overthrow the Republic, and Palpatine became the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of [[Gender/Legends|his]] new empire, allowing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] to control [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="ROTS" /> as the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] planned for.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine would rule the galaxy for years, but was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] by his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], now redeemed to be Anakin Skywalker as he had been before falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], on [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
